t: Easy grip TRV head with energy saving button that alerts to economical setting for comfort. Liquid sensor provides consistent and long lasting performance. Can be mounted horizontally or vertically and includes radiator balancing insert. 6mm play on radiator tailpiece allows for variation in radiator distance from the valve. Compatible with the Evohome Electronic Radiator Controller Head.
